notes: Ids are copied from printed swagger path last segments. access_path is swagger origin + printed basePath + path. No subjectiveforecast id was written onto a met, nowcast, radar, oceanforecast, airquality, tidalwater, sunrise, spotwind, textforecast, icemap, ncagalewarnings, tafmetar, subseasonal, geosatellite, or datanorge row.
License is the printed swagger CC BY 4.0 URL http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0. Publisher is null: the spec prints contact.name Developer Support, not a publisher.
Original harvested swagger metadata stays in harvested_payloads. Fetch writes observations only. enrichments count stayed 0.

Nowcast stays --source nowcast. Metalerts stays --source met. Airqualityforecast stays --source airquality. Tidalwater stays --source tidalwater. Oceanforecast stays --source oceanforecast. NCAgalewarnings stays --source ncagalewarnings. Tafmetar stays --source tafmetar. Subseasonal stays --source subseasonal. Geosatellite stays --source geosatellite after PR 111.
